objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type assigned at creation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document, incremented on content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity check cycle, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data, other documents, IT applications, etc.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document; released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-controlled supplementary document added to a main document, not subject to the release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information is directly published via property switches.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign collective authorizations and distribution membership.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Formal proposal for changes to an existing document, created by an author without affecting the current document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a released document and archive it, processed via workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons maintained per document that controls email notifications and acknowledgement requests upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that drives approval steps such as creation sign-off, review and release.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Active confirmation by a recipient that they have taken note of a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User- and role-specific view presenting relevant documents, tasks and evaluation reports.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report providing filtered search and status information on documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Kind of report (e.g. Status Report, Search, Acknowledgement Status).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable filter criteria that influence evaluation results.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new object.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The selected template, if any, used for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are entered or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process (Creator – Review – Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step confirming document creation.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness within the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content or attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment object is added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: A non-controlled supplementary document is added to a main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is directly removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before expiry.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) confirms extended validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except archive group are revoked and archive duration starts.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is re-validated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to a document via User Groups or person-level attributes.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and User Groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and User Groups on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms that they have taken note of the released document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is permanently deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary content attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal is created for and linked to a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request For Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and selected when creating a Document.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notifications and acknowledgement.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original in multi-client system).
A User Group contains Users who share collective authorizations.
A Distribution List includes User Groups whose members receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A Distribution List can include individual Users directly.
